title: Novel Proline Derivatives for Treating COVID-19
abstract: Abstract: COVID-19 is a contagious disease. Paxlovid, a combination of Nirmatrelvir and Ritonavir, was granted emergency use authorization by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of COVID-19 on December 22, 2021. These are peptidomimetic coronavirus main protease inhibitors. Nirmatrelvir is a proline derivative. The present patent describes similar proline- like compounds, their preparation, use, pharmaceutical composition, and treatment.
